scope: G2 mechanism comparison with AgentFS, native ordinary files and Git as existing version facility; not production capture/restore component

cases.input: Real ordinary Surface/Workspace directories with template, block, report and a file ignored by .gitignore; Git metadata outside those directories; force-add governed file scope while writers stopped
cases.oracle: Native shell/Python reads initial/current files; recorded archive restored into new directories returns exact earlier bytes including ignored-but-governed file. No original worktree/cache needed for read.

cases.input: Surface and Workspace independently advance; append external-control effect fact after first versions; restore only Surface old version
cases.oracle: Surface old bytes restored, Workspace newer bytes and external-control fact remain; rollback cannot erase true effects. Pairing version references remains explicit.

cases.input: Change template T0->T1 but leave block B0 and capture before its later B1 write
cases.oracle: Git records actual T1/B0 mixed application version; a commit alone cannot prove multi-file input coherence. Requires writer coordination/version-collection contract.

cases.input: Separate ordinary git add without force when ignored governed file exists
cases.oracle: Archive lacks ignored file while source still contains it, rejecting the wrong assumption default tracked set equals governed state.

stop: Four finite trajectories, no models/remote effects, only newly created cache directories; retain original commit/tree/ls-files and restored hashes. Exceptions/missing observations FAIL. This fixture does not claim symlink-safe arbitrary restoration or atomic snapshot while writers race.
